leadStory: FSG's agreed sale of a strategic stake of about a third to the Bhatia-led, Bezos-backed consortium (Eduardo Saverin also involved) near a £4.4bn valuation is now expected to be announced this week, Fenway retaining control and Al Jazeera reporting fans seeking clarity. On the pitch the Barcola chase reached a crossroads: PSG hold near £145m and named him in their Super Cup squad, Arsenal moved to hijack after losing Vinicius to a new Madrid deal, and Liverpool weighed walking away, with Mbaye the Paris winger they now most realistically land. Araujo (loan) and Jacquet are set to feature against Como on Sunday.
subject: Anfield exterior and the FSG boardroom era turning over, an ownership headline the size of the summer, no single hero moment
